settings.fab.title: Floating button and shortcuts
settings.fab.info1: The floating button in the bottom right corner of every page. Press it to open the chat, give a voice command or start a quick scan. Hide it if it gets in the way; you can always bring it back here.
settings.fab.info2: While the button is hidden, the chat and voice commands cannot be opened until you show it again. This setting applies to your account only.
settings.ws.title: Speech-to-text (local Whisper)
settings.ws.b1: Whisper turns a spoken command into text on this computer. The audio never leaves the machine and is not stored. It takes about 1 to 2 seconds per command on an NVIDIA graphics card and much longer on the CPU (about 8 to 17 seconds).
settings.ws.b2: starts or stops the Whisper program. Starting takes about 10 to 20 seconds to load the model. It is one program shared by every administrator, so stopping it affects everyone.
settings.ws.b3: the microphone button uses the browser's own speech engine instead, automatically.
settings.ws.b4: sends the audio to the browser's maker (Chrome to Google, Edge to Microsoft), so it needs the internet, and in tests it misreads IP addresses more often than Whisper does.
settings.ws.b5h: After shutting down or restarting the computer:
settings.ws.b5: Whisper does not start by itself. Turn the switch on again, or double-click
settings.ws.b5b: in the project folder. Reloading the app does not stop Whisper.
settings.ws.browser_only: Always use the browser's speech engine, even when Whisper is running (this browser only)
settings.ws.loading: Starting… loading the model takes about 10 to 20 seconds
settings.ws.stopped: Not running · using the browser's speech engine
settings.ws.not_installed: Whisper is not installed on this computer (the folder clylar-whisper-lab was not found)
settings.ws.slow: Loading is taking unusually long. See the reason in instance/whisper_worker.log
settings.ws.err_missing: The Whisper program was not found on this computer
settings.ai.title: AI assistant
settings.ai.b1: the system calls no AI model at all, neither Gemini nor the local model, even if a personal key is set, so no tokens are used. Questions the system cannot answer itself get no answer until the AI is switched on.
settings.ai.b2: commands the system understands by itself, both voice commands and commands typed on the Assistant page, such as starting a scan, opening a page, or asking how many devices, ports and vulnerabilities there are.
settings.ai.b3: your own API key first (only for questions from your account). If none is set, the shared system key set by the superadministrator. If neither is set, GOOGLE_API_KEY from the .env file.
settings.ai.b4: as files on the server in the instance folder, not in the database or in git, and they are never shown again after saving.
settings.ai.b5: questions sent to Gemini carry summary figures from the scan results. With a personal key this goes to the key owner's Google account, so the superadministrator can turn personal keys off.
settings.ai.b6: the figures in the table are the tokens Google reports back for every call (including the tokens the model uses to think). A call that fails before an answer has no tokens. The test button uses no tokens and is not counted in the table. The local model uses none of Google's tokens, so its calls are not in the token rows.
settings.ai.superadmin_only: Only the superadministrator can change this setting.
settings.ai.my_hint: Used only for the questions you ask the assistant, and calls Gemini through your own Google account. If it is not set, the system key is used instead.
settings.ai.shared_hint_ro: Used for administrators who have not set their own key. Only the superadministrator can set it.
settings.ai.shared_hint: Used for administrators who have not set their own key. If it is not set on this page, GOOGLE_API_KEY from the .env file is used.
settings.ai.paste_label: Paste an API key from Google AI Studio
settings.ai.personal_label: Allow administrators to use their own key
settings.ai.confirm_my: Delete your key? The system key will be used instead (if there is one).
settings.ai.confirm_shared: Delete the system key set on this page? The value in the .env file will be used instead (if there is one).
settings.ai.my_disabled: · switched off, the system key is in use
settings.ai.my_unset_shared: Not set · the system key is in use
settings.ai.my_unset_none: Not set · the AI assistant cannot be used until a key is set
settings.ai.confirm_gemini: Switch to Gemini? Questions to the assistant will be sent to Google together with summary figures from the scan results. The local model keeps them on the computer that runs the app. Continue?
settings.ai.local_starting: Ollama has not answered yet and may be starting. Please wait (waited {t}, up to about {max})
settings.ai.help_s1_b: Open the Ollama program on the computer that runs the scanner, then come back and press the connection test again.
settings.ai.help_s2_b: After the computer or Ollama starts, it can take 1 to 2 minutes to be ready. The first question after that is slow because the model has to load first.
settings.ai.help_s3_t: Close it and open it again
settings.ai.help_s3_b: If it still fails, close the Ollama program and open it again, then wait a moment and press the connection test again.
settings.ai.help_s4_t: Check that the model is downloaded
settings.ai.help_s4_b: If it says the model is missing, download it with PowerShell. Press the Windows key, type PowerShell and press Enter. Then paste the command below, press Enter and wait until the download finishes.
settings.ai.help_s5_b: Ollama's usual address is http://127.0.0.1:11434. You can check it in the model settings on this card. If it still fails, tell whoever looks after the computer.

settings.ai.switch_failed: Could not change the setting (superadministrator only)
settings.ai.engine_saved_local: Switched to the local model. The data in questions stays on the computer that runs the app.
settings.ai.local_layers_hint: Leave empty to let Ollama decide. Lower it if the GPU runs out of memory while Whisper is loaded (default {n}).
settings.ai.b9: The AI sees every total, but only part of the device, vulnerability and scan lists, so a question does not get too long. The most important items come first. The local model sees fewer than Gemini because it can read less at once. If you ask about an IP address or CVE ID, the details of that item are always sent.
settings.ai.b8h: If the local model does not answer:
settings.ai.b8: If it says "Ollama did not answer in time", wait 1 to 2 minutes after the computer or Ollama starts and press Test again. If that does not help, try closing the Ollama program and starting it again. If it says the model is missing, download it with the command ollama pull followed by the model name. The first question after Ollama starts is slow because the model has to load; later ones are faster.
settings.ai.b7: runs Typhoon through Ollama on the computer that runs the app. The data in questions is not sent to Google, but answers are usually slower and less accurate than Gemini. If Ollama is not ready the system says it cannot connect, and does not send the question to Gemini instead.
